name: trek-plugin-airbnb-mcp
description: TREK trip-page plugin: search Airbnb via each traveller's own OpenBnB MCP account.

scripts.smoke: npx -y trek-plugin-sdk pack >/dev/null && rm -rf .smoke && mkdir -p .smoke && cd .smoke && unzip -oq ../plugin.zip && cd .. && node scripts/smoke.mjs .smoke/client/index.html
scripts.shot: npm run --silent smoke >/dev/null; node scripts/screenshot.mjs .smoke/client/index.html docs/screenshot.png
